main.summary: Immutable published-content snapshot used to open readable segmented transfer sessions.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Catalog-owned item instance token represented by the published snapshot.

property.name: ObjectSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the serialized published object payload.

property.name: Integrity
property.summary: Server-authoritative ordered integrity summary for the published stream payload.

property.name: IntegritySegments
property.summary: Canonical published segments used to compute the stream integrity summary.

property.name: RealizedRanges
property.summary: Initially realized ranges available to readable segmented sessions.

property.name: ObjectInfo
property.summary: Optional descriptive object summary for the published payload.
